transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net entertainment support, my name is Toby. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Toby. I am really annoyed about our entertainment add-on. We signed up for the S-Net Netflix and Disney Plus bundle ten days ago, but the activation link in the email expired after seven days before we could link our accounts, and now the portal says our voucher is invalid!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can inspect your entertainment package entitlement. First let me complete security verification. What is your full name and billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hamza Malik, 27 Parkside Drive, Watford, WD17 3BN.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the four-digit security PIN on the account, Hamza?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What email address do you currently use for your existing Netflix account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I use hamza dot malik dot film at gmail dot com for Netflix.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And did you click the activation link in the onboarding email before the seven-day cutoff?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I was travelling for business all last week, and when I clicked it on Sunday night it showed Error 410 Link Expired.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Third-party subscription tokens are generated and managed by Netflix and Disney partner APIs, so if the link expires, that's essentially Netflix's problem, not S-Net's.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What do you mean it's Netflix's problem? S-Net billed me fifteen pounds for this bundle on my S-Net bill! My kids have been crying all weekend because they can't watch their Disney movies!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you sat on the activation email for an entire week without clicking it, you only have yourself to blame.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I was at my grandmother's funeral, Toby! That is a disgraceful and heartless thing to say to a paying customer!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: As I said, automated partner security tokens have a strict seven-day cryptographic lifespan to prevent fraud.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you generate a fresh token or refund my fifteen pounds?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the account details. What was the email address you use for your Netflix account again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Like I said three minutes ago, it's hamza dot malik dot film at gmail dot com.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a moment while I access the partner merchant console to revoke the expired token and issue a fresh pair.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Hamza. I have accessed the wholesale entitlement bridge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you generate new links?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I have purged the expired tokens and generated fresh activation URLs for both Netflix Premium and Disney Plus Standard.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you know that your S-Net entertainment bundle also includes the S-Net TV Go mobile app for live channels?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I didn't realize that was included. Does it work on iPads?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, up to two devices can stream live sports and entertainment channels simultaneously via the TV Go app.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will be really handy when my wife wants to watch her dramas and I want the football.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You simply log into the app using your primary S-Net username and password.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'll download it on the iPad this evening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can manage your streaming bundles anytime under the Add-ons tab in the My S-Net portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know I can swap packages if we want to change tiers later.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And there are no long-term tie-ins on the entertainment add-on; it operates on a rolling thirty-day basis.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That flexibility is great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you will see the fifteen-pound itemized charge under 'Entertainment Services' on your monthly PDF bill.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood, clear itemization helps keep track.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you send the links to my mobile phone so I can activate them right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have just dispatched both one-click activation links via SMS to your mobile phone ending in 819.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Just got the SMS! Two links received.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tap the first link for Netflix first. It will prompt you to sign in with your existing Netflix credentials.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapping the Netflix link... Entering my password... It says 'Success! Your S-Net bundle is now linked. Your payment method has been switched to S-Net billing, £0.00 due to Netflix.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms your existing Netflix profile, watchlist, and viewing history are fully preserved without double billing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That was completely seamless. Now tapping the Disney Plus link.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Follow the same step: enter your email and log in to link the subscription.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Entered email and password... It says 'Welcome to Disney Plus via S-Net. Your subscription is active!'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you open the Disney Plus app on your television or phone to confirm full streaming access?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Opening Disney app on my phone... Playing Moana... Playing in crystal clear 4K with Dolby Atmos audio!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms both streaming entitlements are fully authenticated and operational.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The kids will be thrilled when they get home from school.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your billing contact email on file, it's hamza dot malik at london dot co dot uk, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my primary billing email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just confirming before we close the ticket, the billing address is 27 Parkside Drive, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 27 Parkside Drive.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will leave notes on your account confirming that both partner tokens were reissued and linked successfully.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for getting the links re-generated Toby.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your entertainment add-on that I can help with today, Hamza?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, both apps are working properly now. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Hamza, and enjoy your streaming.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye.
